data.content_ref: inline:Strengthen the grounded extension at the edge-construction layer, never the fixpoint: define an admissible enrichment as any polynomial-time function that adds attack edges monotonically (no deletions) to the subgraph induced by non-committed-root nodes. Because label0 is monotone in att, the unique grounded fixpoint, polynomial cost, and reinstatement-as-derived all survive unchanged; the conjecture is that the validity guarantee reduces exactly to the constraint that no enrichment adds an attacker to a committed root, making 'no new attacker on a root' the single load-bearing check.
